title: configuration-interval seek

definition.title: configuration-interval seek
definition.source_excerpt: Two independently authored Annex-B H.264 segments were concatenated: 3 s at 320×180 followed by 3 s at 640×360, both with repeated headers and 1 s keyframe cadence. The index records SPS configuration intervals and starts the second interval at its SPS/RAP boundary. Result. FFprobe on the full stream observes the resolution switch at frame 90 and the first 640×360 frame is a keyframe. The indexed second interval begins exactly at the second authored stream boundary (280,871 bytes) and is byte-identical to that authored stream. Frame 30 from the indexed interval is pixel-identical to frame 30 decoded from the authored second segment (dc278b9cdc52751edf076f9bf98e3815705e8c39081739c9e3a31670fa1fd11f). Starting at a non-RAP slice emits missing PPS/dependency errors, proving the entry/preroll requirement matters.
